categories.Name: Why Do We Need a New Framework?
categories.Description: The opening category explains why modern physics may still require deeper unification, beginning with symmetry, nilpotency and the mathematical character of physical law.

categories.Name: Building the SYMMETRIA Framework
categories.Description: The second category introduces the conceptual building blocks of SYMMETRIA, including emergence, layered reality, information and framework architecture.

categories.Name: Exploring Reality
categories.Description: The third category explores how SYMMETRIA might reinterpret core physical concepts such as spacetime, mass, complexity and the observer boundary.

categories.Name: From Theory to Science
categories.Description: The final category asks how SYMMETRIA could move from speculative theory toward modelling, testing, research frontiers and scientific evaluation.

papers.Title: Why Physics Still Needs a Unified Framework
papers.Category: Why Do We Need a New Framework?
papers.Purpose: Introduces the continuing gap between the Standard Model, General Relativity and the wider search for a deeper unifying framework.

papers.Title: Symmetry - Nature's Hidden Language
papers.Category: Why Do We Need a New Framework?
papers.Purpose: Explores symmetry, conservation laws and why symmetry may point toward deeper organising principles in nature.

papers.Title: The Nilpotent Foundation
papers.Category: Why Do We Need a New Framework?
papers.Purpose: Introduces nilpotent algebra and explains why zero-square structures may provide a useful foundation for exploratory unification work.

papers.Title: Mathematics, Elegance and Reality
papers.Category: Why Do We Need a New Framework?
papers.Purpose: Explores why mathematics describes nature so effectively and why elegance alone can inspire but never validate a theory.

papers.Title: Emergence and Layered Reality
papers.Purpose: Explores emergence, hierarchy and the possibility that physical systems arise through layered relationships.

papers.Title: Beyond the Four Fundamental Forces
papers.Purpose: Considers whether deeper relationships may underlie the known interactions and their apparent separation.

papers.Title: Fields, Information and Structure
papers.Purpose: Investigates how field relationships, information structures and measurement boundaries may be connected within an exploratory framework.

papers.Title: The Architecture of SYMMETRIA
papers.Purpose: Outlines the conceptual structure of SYMMETRIA and how its internal components relate to one another.

papers.Title: Space, Time and Geometry
papers.Purpose: Explores spacetime, geometry and the possibility that physical structure may emerge from deeper relationships.

papers.Title: Mass, Inertia and Symmetry Collapse
papers.Purpose: Examines how mass, inertia and related properties may be interpreted as outcomes of symmetry breaking and field collapse.

papers.Title: Complexity, Order and Emergence
papers.Purpose: Considers how complex systems may arise from simpler underlying principles through order, feedback and emergence.

papers.Title: The Observer Frontier
papers.Purpose: Introduces the observer and measurement boundary as a frontier issue without making claims about consciousness as established physics.

papers.Title: Predictions, Models and Falsifiability
papers.Purpose: Explains how an exploratory framework must move toward predictions, modelling and possible falsification.

papers.Title: The Nilpotent Symmetry Research Program
papers.Purpose: Introduces the NSRP and the role of modelling, critique, AI assistance and computational research in testing the framework.

papers.Title: From Theory to Technology: The Five Research Frontiers of SymTech Ventures
papers.Purpose: Explores the five SymTech Ventures divisions as long-term research frontiers inspired by SYMMETRIA if the framework proves scientifically useful.

papers.Title: Towards a New Scientific Paradigm
papers.Purpose: Brings the series together and considers how a speculative framework could mature into a disciplined scientific research programme.
